item.subject: launch checklist link?
item.body:
Hey, I'm on my phone in Lagos and can't find the shared Beam launch checklist doc. Can you send me the link? I want to update the benchmarks line before Wednesday's go/no-go.

D

# Daniel Okafor

Cofounder and CTO. We met at Segment in 2019; he wrote the first Beam prototype over a weekend.

- Owns the Beam runtime, the trace format and infra (our [[finance/vendors|Northwind Cloud]] account).
- In Lagos Sep 26 – Oct 3 for his sister's wedding; online in the mornings Pacific time.
- Prefers Slack for quick things, email for anything with a decision in it.
- Has signing authority up to $5k but never uses it — sends invoices to me.

## Open threads
- Beam 1.0 go/no-go on Wed Sep 30 ([[projects/beam-launch]]).
- Wants a second GPU reservation from Northwind for benchmark runs in October.
